screenplay_source.heading: INT. ANAADHI’S RAISED CABIN – CONTINUOUS
screenplay_source.end_boundary: Cabin darkness becomes a bright university laboratory; ANAADHI V.O. says Then, a system; source screenplay SMASH CUT TO SC006, but final locked editorial order next is SC099B.

ANAADHI.constraints: topless; shaved rough regrowth; ADK-7 affected; floor-level; hands free

AARATHI_REAL.constraints: civilian field clothes; wet plait; no weapon

props.PRP-PARAANE-EMBLEM: physical case emblem; all rotations/morphs represented only
props.PRP-ADK7-CARTRIDGE: already discharged in SC004; no new action

technology.PULSE_DISPLAY: physical clinical monitoring display required by screenplay; no standalone approved master asserted

damage_rules: represented emblem/diagram/lab layers leave zero physical residue

special_transformation.boundary_start: The Paraane emblem becomes a rotating academic diagram.
special_transformation.boundary_end: The cabin darkness becomes a bright university laboratory.
rules: initial Hospital/Police/Government/Sarjanya cycle is distorted perception before TP005 onset
academic diagram is represented content only
bright university laboratory is chronology bridge, not transformed cabin or portal
final editorial next segment is SC099B

shots.purpose: inherit SC004 final physical emblem close-up and begin distorted rotation
shots.subject_placement: Paraane case emblem fills frame
shots.orientation_notes: pre-SB005 represented perception over physical case
shots.visual_prompt: The real Paraane emblem on the medical case fills Anaadhi’s distorted floor-level sight and appears to rotate while the breached wet cabin stays blurred behind it.
shots.negative_constraints: no pristine cabin; no second breach; no academic diagram yet; no actual rotating hardware
shots.continuity_anchor: physical WC001/E plus distorted emblem perception

shots.purpose: Hospital symbolic reading
shots.subject_placement: single hospital-coded variation center
shots.visual_prompt: The same physical emblem is perceived for one instant as a restrained hospital-coded symbolic variation.
shots.negative_constraints: no hospital room; no invented readable hospital logo; no physical replacement object

shots.purpose: Police symbolic reading
shots.subject_placement: single police-coded variation center
shots.visual_prompt: The emblem shifts in Anaadhi’s distorted sight into a police-coded symbolic variation.
shots.negative_constraints: no police headquarters; no invented badge/logo; no physical replacement object

shots.purpose: Government symbolic reading
shots.subject_placement: single governance-coded variation center
shots.visual_prompt: The emblem shifts into a governance-coded symbolic variation while the real case remains unchanged underneath.
shots.negative_constraints: no government chamber; no national-emblem invention; no readable seal

shots.purpose: Sarjanya symbolic reading and four-symbol merge
shots.subject_placement: four source-named symbolic states collapse toward one center
shots.visual_prompt: Hospital, Police, Government and Sarjanya symbolic readings of the Paraane emblem converge into one perceived form over the unchanged medical-case emblem.
shots.negative_constraints: no four physical badges; no new logos; no literal institutional merger; no residue

shots.purpose: Medical Specialist checks Anaadhi pulse display
shots.subject_placement: Specialist and pulse display midframe; Anaadhi low foreground
shots.visual_prompt: The Medical Specialist checks a restrained clinical pulse display beside floor-level Anaadhi in the breached wet cabin; no new treatment action occurs.
shots.negative_constraints: no futuristic HUD spectacle; no invented diagnosis; no injection; no pristine floor
dialogue: MEDICAL SPECIALIST: The drug is circulating rapidly.

shots.purpose: Aarathi challenges absence of baseline
shots.subject_placement: Aarathi dominant; Specialist and display secondary
shots.visual_prompt: Wet-plait Aarathi, still unarmed, challenges the Specialist while Anaadhi remains low and weak; pulse display secondary.
shots.negative_constraints: no weapon on Aarathi; no parallel Aarathi; no invented medical chart
dialogue: AARATHI: You do not know his baseline record.

shots.purpose: Specialist invokes Paraane complete record
shots.subject_placement: Specialist center; case and display restrained
shots.visual_prompt: The Specialist answers that Paraane has Anaadhi’s complete record; keep the statement procedural and the cabin unchanged.
shots.negative_constraints: no floating record files; no archive room; no new screen graphics
dialogue: MEDICAL SPECIALIST: Paraane has his complete record.

shots.purpose: Anaadhi hears claim; fingers stop
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi hand foreground; body soft behind
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi’s moving fingers stop against the wet wooden floor the instant he hears that Paraane has his complete record.
shots.negative_constraints: no standing; no long hair; no split-floor opening; no new injury

shots.purpose: broken whisper My record
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi face low center
shots.visual_prompt: Topless sedated Anaadhi with shaved rough regrowth whispers from the floor, disturbed by the record claim.
shots.negative_constraints: no heroic pose; no clean standing portrait

shots.purpose: Specialist leans closer and asks What
shots.subject_placement: Specialist leans into low eyeline
shots.visual_prompt: The Specialist leans closer to hear Anaadhi without touching or restraining him.
shots.negative_constraints: no extra injection; no medical violence

shots.purpose: Anaadhi looks back to physical Paraane emblem
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi eyeline toward emblem
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi turns his weakened gaze back to the physical Paraane emblem on the medical case.
shots.negative_constraints: no academic diagram yet; no physical symbol morph

shots.purpose: It reached there before I did
shots.subject_placement: Anaadhi profile and emblem on opposite depth planes
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi whispers toward the case emblem, recognizing that his institutional record existed before his own arrival.
shots.negative_constraints: no literal files entering building; no flashback invention
dialogue: ANAADHI: It reached there before I did.

shots.purpose: Police Commander gestures for restraints
shots.subject_placement: Commander gesture foreground; Anaadhi hands visible free
shots.visual_prompt: Police Commander signals for restraints while Anaadhi’s hands remain visibly free on the floor.
shots.negative_constraints: no cuffs already attached; no struggle invented

shots.purpose: Semmaa intervenes to keep hands free
shots.subject_placement: Semmaa center; Anaadhi low background
shots.visual_prompt: Semmaa watches Anaadhi carefully and counters the restraint gesture, insisting his hands stay free because he is not fighting.
shots.negative_constraints: no aggressive hero pose; no weapon discharge
dialogue: SEMMAA: Keep his hands free. He is not fighting now.

shots.purpose: Police Commander replies Not yet
shots.subject_placement: Commander center; Anaadhi low edge
shots.visual_prompt: The Police Commander answers Semmaa with guarded suspicion while Anaadhi remains physically weak and unrestrained.
shots.negative_constraints: no attack; no cuffs applied

shots.purpose: Anaadhi palm presses floor; V.O. before every cage
shots.subject_placement: open palm pressing wet wood foreground
shots.orientation_notes: last fully physical shot before SB005 onset
shots.visual_prompt: Anaadhi presses his palm against the wet wooden floor; the breached cabin, case and armed operation remain real and unchanged.
shots.negative_constraints: no floorboard opening; no academic diagram yet
dialogue: ANAADHI (V.O.): Before every cage, an idea is born.

shots.purpose: TP005 onset: emblem becomes rotating academic diagram
shots.subject_placement: emblem transforms into restrained academic diagram centered
shots.orientation_notes: SB005 begins exactly here; audience-only OBS03
shots.visual_prompt: At the exact TP005 onset, the physical Paraane emblem is represented as a rotating academic diagram while the real case and cabin remain the underlying anchor.
shots.negative_constraints: no physical projector; no literal new device; no new room; no portal

shots.purpose: academic diagram exposes CARE
shots.subject_placement: CARE concept on one diagram axis
shots.visual_prompt: The academic diagram exposes the source-named CARE branch as part of the represented Paraane idea.
shots.negative_constraints: no physical text painted in cabin; no extra departments

shots.purpose: academic diagram adds POLICE and GOVERNANCE
shots.subject_placement: POLICE and GOVERNANCE axes join CARE
shots.visual_prompt: The represented academic diagram expands to the source-named POLICE and GOVERNANCE branches, remaining perceptual reconstruction over the unchanged cabin.
shots.negative_constraints: no police building; no government chamber; no new logo system

shots.purpose: COMMUNITY RESPONSE completes four-part diagram; hope line
shots.subject_placement: four source-named branches balanced around one center
shots.orientation_notes: source labels only; no final logo redesign
shots.visual_prompt: The represented academic diagram completes with CARE, POLICE, GOVERNANCE and COMMUNITY RESPONSE around one concept, matching the screenplay and nothing more.
shots.negative_constraints: no fifth branch; no invented slogan; no physical apparatus
dialogue: ANAADHI (V.O.): On the first day, they call it hope.

shots.purpose: four-part idea tightens into system concept
shots.subject_placement: four branches tighten into integrated system form
shots.orientation_notes: represented logic only; no future Paraane state imported
shots.visual_prompt: The four-part academic diagram tightens into an integrated system concept without becoming a literal machine, room or governing apparatus.
shots.negative_constraints: no mature Paraane visuals; no throne; no later-state buildings

shots.purpose: cabin darkness begins chronology bridge to bright university laboratory
shots.subject_placement: dark cabin geometry yields to bright red-stone university-lab geometry
shots.orientation_notes: RST03 chronology bridge; no traversable portal
shots.visual_prompt: The dark raised-cabin perception transitions into the bright visual language of the university laboratory as a chronology bridge, while no physical portal or route is created.
shots.negative_constraints: no portal door; no characters from SC006; no cabin physically rebuilding into laboratory
shots.continuity_anchor: RST03 bridge toward real past chronology
